Definition: from G1223 and G3563; deep thought, properly, the faculty (mind or its disposition), by implication, its exercise:-- imagination, mind, understanding.
BiblicalUsage: The mind is the seat of understanding, and Scripture calls it to love God with all of it. The greatest commandment takes the whole mind, the Ephesians are told their minds were darkened before they knew Christ, and John writes that the Son of God has given us understanding to know Him who is true.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mind is not the enemy of faith but its instrument. God gave me understanding to know Him, and loving Him with all my mind is the first and great commandment, not an afterthought.
RelatedTopics: Knowledge of God; Love for God; Transformation
